memories.content: As of 2026-06-08, Mara faces a career choice between applying for a permanent position on her ICU unit or a quieter step-down ward posting (less intensity, more sleep), and can only apply to one.

entities.name: the General
entities.description: the hospital where Mara works in the ICU and where Priya is

memories.content: Mara identifies deeply with ICU nursing ('ICU is who i am') and says she still loves the actual job despite being exhausted to her bones.

Mara judged (2026-06-08) that she is angry at the ICU staffing but not at the institution overall, distinguishing her view from Priya's; basis: she still loves the actual job and just wants to sleep and keep helping people.
Priya judged (2026-06-08) that Mara should leave the institution (not the ICU work itself); basis: she is convinced management is incompetent and will never fix the staffing.

entities.name: Priya
entities.description: Mara's colleague at the General, angrier at the organization than Mara

memories.content: When facing the permanent-vs-step-down job decision (2026-06-08), Mara deferred rather than deciding, saying she'll 'sit with it' and 'see what i actually apply for.'
